# LexMinds (`https://lexminds.in`)
> Bridging Legal Education & Industry Practice

## Overview
LexMinds is India's premier legal ecosystem platform dedicated to connecting law students, young advocates, and legal researchers with verified industry internships, high-impact mentorship, and a peer-reviewed, double-blind legal article publishing journal.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Legal Internship Portal (`/internships`)
- **Verified Listings**: Curated internships across Tier-1 law firms, Supreme Court & High Court senior advocate chambers, corporate legal departments, fintech startups, and think tanks.
- **Practice Areas**:
  - Corporate Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) and Securities Law
  - Constitutional & Appellate Litigation
  - Intellectual Property Rights (IPR & Patent Litigation)
  - Technology, Data Privacy & AI Governance
  - Commercial Arbitration & Dispute Resolution
  - Criminal Law & Criminal Jurisprudence (BNS / BNSS / BSA)
- **Application Workflow**: Structured multi-step application with Statement of Purpose (SOP), academic credentials, verified resume submission, and seamless Razorpay processing fee checkout.

### 2. Article Publishing & Legal Journal (`/articles` & `/publish`)
- **Peer-Reviewed Journal**: Publishing authoritative research articles, case commentaries, legislative analyses, and policy briefs.
- **Publish With Us**: Transparent manuscript submission system with anti-plagiarism verification (Turnitin < 10%), double-blind editorial review, and formal certificate of publication.
- **Citation Standards**: Formatted to Indian legal citation standards, Bluebook (21st ed.), and OSCOLA.

### 3. Editorial & Mentorship Network (`/about`)
- Advisory board of Senior Advocates, Partners from leading law firms, and National Law University (NLU) faculty members.
- Practical legal drafting workshops, moot court masterclasses, and career coaching.
